emotionalModulationRules.philosophy: This rule-set defines how specific envelope shapes trigger emotional responses in the listener. Use these curves inside Fruity Envelope Controller to 'Score' the narrative of your Hip-Hop/R&B track.

curveDictionary.name: The Aggressive Snap
curveDictionary.context: Link to Filter Cutoff for high-energy Trap leads. Triggers the brain's 'Threat Response' (High Attention).

curveDictionary.name: The Vulnerable Breath
curveDictionary.context: Link to Reverb Wet or Volume for Moody R&B vocals. Mimics the human intake of air before speaking.

curveDictionary.name: The Psychedelic Drift
curveDictionary.shape: Zero Attack, Infinite Sustain, Random Drifting LFO.
curveDictionary.context: Link to Fine Pitch (±5 cents). Triggers the brain's 'Uncanny Valley' effect (Trippiness).

curveDictionary.name: The Mechanical Stutter
curveDictionary.context: Link to Volume Gate for high-speed Drill hi-hats. Mimics the sound of machinery (The 'Grind').

masterEngineeringLogic.action: Set Articulator Smoothing to 15ms. This 'shaves off' the digital edges of your envelopes, making the transitions feel 'Analog' and expensive.
Use Linear Attack but Exponential Decay for filter sweeps. This creates a 'Whiplash' effect that is synonymous with modern high-end Trap production.

humanizationConstants.philosophy: This data-set provides the mathematical constants required to 'Humanize' digital MIDI data using Fruity Envelope Controller. It targets the biological timing and pressure errors of real performers across various Hip-Hop and R&B sub-genres.

timingEntropy.logic: Adds a ±4ms random drift to every hit. Mimics the mechanical 'un-quantization' of early MPC hardware.

pressureDynamics.logic: Subtle brightness variation based on strike strength.

timingEntropy.logic: Creates a slow, 'Drunken' swing that drifts in and out of time. Mimics a 'lazy' drummer playing behind the beat.

pressureDynamics.logic: Softer notes are more 'Drowned' in reverb; louder notes are 'Dryer' and closer. Mimics intimate distance perception.

timingEntropy.logic: Trap requires 100% rhythmic stability. Humanization should focus on tone, not timing.

pressureDynamics.logic: High-velocity 808s 'Scream' more than quiet ones. Mimics the saturation of analog tape when driven hard.

biologicalConstants.fatigueEmulation: Link 'Smoothing' to Song Position. As the song progresses, the smoothing increases, making the modulations 'lazier' and more 'tired'.

rules.scenario: LFO is drifting out of time
rules.action: Enable BPM Sync and Re-trigger on note

emotionalResponseMapping.logic: The shape of a modulation curve determines the psychological reaction of the listener. In Hip-Hop and R&B, we manipulate these curves to enhance the narrative of the song.

shapes.physics: Slow start, fast finish. High dV/dt at the end of the curve.
shapes.bestUse: Trap snare filter sweeps, Drill hi-hat pitch rolls.

shapes.physics: Fast start, slow finish. Energy dissipates gracefully.
shapes.bestUse: Moody R&B vocal reverb tails, Neo-Soul pad releases.
Sidechain ducking, slow rhythmic melodic filters.

shapes.physics: Instant jump to max, linear fall to zero.
shapes.bestUse: Industrial glitch stutters, rhythmic noise layers.

rhythmicRules.action: Set Envelope Controller Smoothing to >200ms. This 'slows down' the emotional changes, creating a sensation of being drugged or underwater.
Set Smoothing to <10ms. Instant emotional transitions create high-impact, 'staccato' energy that keeps the listener focused.

troubleshootingRules.fix: Increase Smoothing to 5-10ms to round the waveform edges.
Enable 'Sync' and set LFO Phase to 0 deg.
